Under ENABLE_RESULT_STATUS_METADATA (default OFF, read per call, first statement of every predicate) the new pure module app/services/result_gate.py (stdlib + text_sanitize.dedup_brand_name only) provides is_placeholder_identity (on dedup_brand_name(brand, name) or the name, never brand alone), same_identity (R-A5 with the brand condition and the variant/size axis), identity_coherence (two different canonical non-other per-product categories conflict; other never conflicts, R0-4), evidence_coverage under BOTH readings (AUDITABLE = R0 a_strict + real ratings + real two-sided non-tier-3 spec rows + non-sentinel non-low dims with margin >= 3; LITERAL = R0 price_task + ratings + GPT prose lists + dims with margin >= 3), section_status, identity_confidence (unresolved/low/medium/high, no vision signal at base: it is dropped at scs:4210-4224; B3 threads vision_confidences), assess_result -> status in the R-A4 five with ordered reasons. build_comparison_response (response_builder.py:1451; the one writer of metadata.query at :2060-2061) gains a product_categories kwarg and stamps metadata.result_status / identity_confidence / data_coverage / data_coverage_literal / section_status / product_categories, overview.winner.supported, and metadata.winner_index = None on non-supported bodies only (first writer; history_routes:38-39 present-with-None already renders null-neutral: pinned P7), placed after tier_context and before _strip_inference_markers so the chokepoint has already pended non-showable prices (the structural showable predicate equals the chokepoint verdict by position) and tier-3 markers are still readable. scs captures per-product categories immediately before the write-back at :4295-4296 / :4911-4912 and passes them on the three build sites (:3783, :4571, :5411). home_routes skips stamped non-supported rows by result_status (never winner_index) in the savings helper (:163) and smart-pick (:542, Q5). Telemetry: sentry_service.capture_result_status emits ONE synchronous PII-free capture_message('comparison_result_status', level info, enum/int tags only; recomputed from the body via assess_result) at the five delivery exits (text POST :768, GET :951, stream finally success branch :1299 inside the client-gone gate, camera :579 excluding unsuccessful paths, URL :219 which is never stamped per R0-1); never fire_and_forget (the W4-13 ledger records label sequences). Camera vision_ms / vision_moderation_ms / compare_ms are measured with perf_counter and written ONLY into an existing metadata.stage_timings_ms dict under the flag (B1-TIMINGS; DEBUG_STAGE_TIMINGS is process-cached at scs:1066-1075 and true in production). A traces_sampler (sentry-sdk 2.68.1 measured: legacy start_transaction path merges custom_sampling_context {asgi_scope}; precedence sampler > parent > rate) returns 1.0 for the four compare paths under the flag and parent_sampled else 0.1 otherwise (the SDK's own rules 3/4), with traces_sample_rate=0.1 kept for the U8d/observability/retro pins. Unflagged per R-A1(a)/R0-2: VALID_EVENT_TYPES += six scan_*/image_load_failed names, VALID_MATTERED_MOST += six values incl. unsure, FeedbackRequest += optional Literal winner_correct/price_correct/specs_correct written only when non-None (live 027 columns, no migration, T23 untouched). Flag OFF byte-identical on every body and stored row (FY25 nine digests with E1 adding the flag to UNIT_ENV, W4-13 ledger, UR11, metering pins, P1-P8 with full configuration). Three bounded base runs all green (119 / 7 / 225 passed).

stated_limits: L1 identity_confidence has no vision signal at base (dropped at scs:4210-4224); assess_result(vision_confidences=) accepted and ignored until B3; medium means brand empty or no corroborating data
L2 unsupported_category via category_used is unreachable at base (always one of the nine incl. other); reachable only through a per-product category conflict

L3 the tier-3 exclusion reads specs._field_confidence[field] == 'tier3_synthesis' (lifted at scs:3443, survives to the stamp); stored rows carry it on 3/52 corpus products, so B2 must honour the STAMPED status on old rows
L4 the strict dims reading treats a score of exactly 50 on either side as the MISSING_SCORE sentinel (a genuine calibrated 50 is excluded too)
L5 the literal fact (c) counts the GPT prose lists (R0's tally); _build_specs_rows still emits N/A vs N/A rows (C1/B5 item, not fixed here)
L6 a stamped non-supported History row ships winner_index None and both image urls None (history_routes:73-74): build 3 shows no winner highlight and placeholder tiles until C1
L7 the Sentry message is subject to the SDK event sample_rate and the project quota; the sampler raises compare transactions to 100 % (owner reads the Sentry quota before the flip)
L8 the stream emits no message when the client left before complete (not a delivery, refunded), so stream telemetry counts deliveries only
L9 URL bodies: telemetry only, never stamped (R0-1/B4); no showable prices and no scoring_v2 there, so the URL status is mostly partial_no_winner
L10 metadata.winner_index is written only on non-supported bodies; supported bodies keep the key absent (History fallback to comparison.winner_index unchanged)
L11 the Home readers key on the stored stamp and read no flag: pre-flip rows count as today; rows stamped during a window stay skipped after a rollback
L12 six per-call flag reads: a mid-request flip can yield a stamped body without a message or the reverse for one in-flight request
L13 profile_routes.py:75/:97/:141 (recent decisions) still read the top-level winner_index (Q7)
L14 DEBUG_STAGE_TIMINGS is process-cached (scs:1066-1075); the three camera timing keys appear only where the memo was true; tests reset the memo
L15 offline sizing (R0-5): 4/27 corpus rows abstain under the AUDITABLE reading (3/16 camera); the identity half has 0 corpus hits and is what the flag measures in production
L16 same_identity's variant/size axis compares variant / size_or_count / distinguishing_features present on the product dicts; at base only variant (from size_or_count on the vision path) exists
L17 camera vision_ms excludes the multipart read and transcoding before :310; compare_ms is the compare_from_text wall only
